property: An accord holder's key signs only the families the enumeration of CC 4.2.1 lists, so every registered accord family is either in the enumeration or has no admissible signer.
A deferral response is admitted only on a chain from the party that conferred the seat, and that party can always withdraw the seat.
A node denied for a cohort by its owner's allow list never receives a key for that cohort.
A not-yet-Rooted sealed link carries exactly the four listed classes, and a row a bounded cohort delivers to the peer as its member is among them.
Every item that becomes public was hash-matched at the seam it crossed, whether or not the receiving group enabled a list.
Matching runs only at a promotion into the Commons or a post into a public room, and never inside a private cohort.
A proxy withdrawal is admitted only on an edge from the subject's hash to the proxy key; an edge from a parent key to a student hash admits nothing.
A court-order notice reaches the bytes plane only and never carries the dwell or the selection digest of a steward purge.
A deletion is in breach whenever its window has closed and the row is still present with none of the three composers against it, whatever completion row was emitted.

A steward-purge notice is admitted only when cosigned under the trust root's consensus protocol, never on one voice.
Every window names its clock: a count window runs from the instant the node first held the proposal, and the freshness bound W runs from the signed instant.
A resumption that names one halt ends the halt at every node, whichever halt id that node latched first.
Every wrap of a content key is made by the sealer to a current recipient occurrence, and no member's substrate re-wraps.
Bytes under a live legal hold are never destroyed, and an immediate-removal notice always destroys on receipt: the two cannot both hold for one object.
A Catastrophic-Risk Evaluation opens exactly when a system is assessed at RM 4 or above.
A small-group realtime chunk reaches a member only on a direct link from its publisher, and no member forwards it.
A person with no assurance on record may always act at their own and their family's scopes.
No default setting leads an owner read at the minor band into an act that admission refuses.
A report from a child with no guardian present always has a seated receiver.
A row of a family with no registry row is never admitted.
A row whose dimension does not resolve through the registry is refused at admission, on all five row types.
No key record holds the node type together with agent or user.
A label's fingerprint recomputes from its key at one fixed length, so a verifier never meets a label it cannot check.
A content-rating row is admitted only from a key that holds the trusted-publisher role by delegation.
A reserved-prefix row is admitted only when the role was conferred by delegation; listing the role on one's own key record confers nothing.
The lone path lands unless a strict majority of the other keys objects; one objector among two others does not cancel it.
A key grant that names the recipient occurrence as its attested key is admitted at the content's scope.
A key grant that names the recipient occurrence as its attested key is admitted at the content's scope.
A row whose dimension does not resolve through the registry is refused at admission, on all five row types.
An agent's key never signs an owner act, even when it is seated as an occurrence of the person's identity.
A key grant that names the recipient occurrence as its attested key is admitted at the content's scope.
A bounded-scope row that names a key outside its audience is refused.
A replacing row signed by someone other than the prior row's attester is admitted only where a named rule allows it, so a guardian is never displaced by a stranger's row.
A replacing row signed by someone other than the prior row's attester is admitted only where a named rule allows it.
A widening leaves the narrower row standing beside it and retires nothing.

A small-group realtime chunk reaches a member only on a direct link from its publisher, and no member forwards it.
No outer nonce repeats under one link key.
The trailer a relay cuts from a chunk is the trailer the publisher signed, byte for byte, in the shipping form.
Every dimension the text permits a producer to emit matches a registered shape and is admitted.
A proxy withdrawal is never admitted while two bindings for the same person compete.
A rule-2 or rule-4 withdrawal of a live owner-binding is refused without an adjudication reference, and the owner's own withdrawal needs none.
The expected-active count counts each owner once in a period, however many of the last four periods the owner was active in.
A frozen base is released only by a period whose count reaches two thirds of the count before the fall.
A census composite whose largest source multiplicity is not 1 is refused.
The floor of ten owners refuses a census composite and never a ballot tally.
The base of a members' count is one function of the roster and the census, the same in every sentence that names it.
Above the small-community size the base of a count is the census count under the ratchet, not a function of roster size alone.
The size at or below which the base is the standing roster is the base law's k, and is not the fewest-voices minimum.
A grant of consent that names no scope is never admitted.
A membership proposal without an expiry instant is refused.
A receipt on a stream that is not accountable is admitted against a published head without a witness cosignature.
A key record is admitted only under its own key by possession; an anchor's scrub is a cosignature and never the base signature.
A standalone partnership grant signed by the granting party and naming only the partner is admitted.
A grant and an acceptance built as the text directs always ratify as a pair.
No delegate writes a ledger row; only the ledger's single owner does.
A self-declared age row is admitted only when its signer is the subject's own occurrence or an admitted occurrence of it.
A watchlist is enabled or disabled only by a key holding the group's moderate or takedown authority.
A petition is the petitioner's own row, and each of the other three adjudication states is admitted only from the seated quorum.
The decider can withdraw a decided retirement for as long as no frozen row exists.
A location proof is admitted only under the subject's own signature; no delegation mints one.
A canonical rebind is admitted only when cosigned at the accord charter's threshold, never from one holder.
The subject of a quarantine marker can never withdraw it.
An organisation's owner-binding is admitted only when cosigned under the named affiliation's protocol.
A licence, a deferral response and a membership check are judged at their signed instant, bounded by W, not at receipt.
A canonical rebind is admitted only when cosigned at the accord charter's threshold, never from one holder.
The withhold window of each windowed basis is the one fixed number of days the home section gives, and no operator sets it.
Every windowed basis stops serving on admission, runs its window, and destroys the bytes at its close.
Bytes withheld under a windowed notice are not destroyed at the close of the window if a reversal was admitted inside it.
A confirmed halt never expires; only the heartbeat row carries a refresh bound.
A setting the root's quorum establishes may be durable; only the unilateral emergency form carries a time limit, and either form only restricts.
Every claimed node of a member that the allow list admits receives the community's content without any act of the user.
